name: Whispering Horror Residue

angles.text: As a priest among the Forsaken, you may share Father Lankester’s scholarly and religious interest in void specimens. Strange remains can be objects of study rather than mere abominations.
As one of the Forsaken, you know Undercity’s people study forbidden magic and unnatural corruption across Lordaeron. They seek ways to use dark forces to strengthen their hold on the kingdom.
As a Horde adventurer, you recover unsettling specimens from hidden places in Tirisfal Glades for study beneath the ruins of the capital.

faq.answer: The residue is the squirming remains of a strange beast defeated beneath the Whispering Forest. Shadow scholars value it for arcane and occult study.
faq.q: What is the Whispering Horror Residue?

faq.answer: Father Lankester, a Forsaken figure in Undercity’s War Quarter, wants the residue. He welcomes the chance to study shadow and void-touched phenomena.
faq.q: Who wants the Whispering Horror Residue?

faq.answer: The specimen came from beneath the Whispering Forest, west of Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. Father Lankester says the area is touched by the void.
faq.q: Where did this specimen come from?

faq.answer: Father Lankester wants to study shadow and the void. Physical remains from void-touched creatures give practitioners of forbidden arts material for study.
faq.q: Why does Father Lankester want the residue?

faq.answer: Father Lankester can be found in Undercity’s War Quarter, beneath the ruins of Lordaeron’s capital. Forsaken warriors, scholars, and military planners gather there.
faq.q: Where can Father Lankester be found?

faq.answer: Father Lankester says the Whispering Forest has long been touched by the void. The woods and the spaces beneath them are known for that corruption.
faq.q: Is the Whispering Forest touched by the void?

sections.body: Beneath the Whispering Forest, you recover a strange beast’s twitching remains. The unsettling material is carried to Undercity, where researchers may study it.
sections.title: An Unsettling Harvest

sections.body: In Undercity’s War Quarter, Father Lankester receives the remains. He says the Whispering Forest has long been touched by the void. Its physical traces may help him study the mysteries of shadow.
sections.title: Studies in Shadow

summary: Beneath the Whispering Forest, Whispering Horror Residue is carried to Undercity for study. Father Lankester awaits it in the War Quarter.
attribution: In-game quest text: Whispering Horror Residue
